title: Translating the prime-scale origin puts every row sum below 97/100 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, every off-diagonal row sum on the 10-vertex path is strictly below `97/100`. The backward-only last row is strictly below `1/1000`. The infinity-norm row gap exceeds `3/100`.
- The forward step from vertex 0 equals `exp(-9 pi/722)` and is strictly below `193/200`. Every other in-band entry is at most `exp(-6462 pi/361)`. A row has at most one forward step and three other entries, and that majorant covers all ten rows.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. The centred origin of the preceding audit had a row sum above 1; this translate does not.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -I -B research/gaussian-prime-origin/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-prime-origin`
- [ ] Maintainer replay of the registered package
